data.name: Kalicharan
data.gender_notes: Kalicharan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kalicharan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kali' meaning time or cycle and 'Chara' meaning one who moves or one who carries. This name signifies the one who is carried by the cycle of time or the one who moves through the cycles of life with the grace of God. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often referred to as 'Kali-Ma' and the 'destroyer of cycles of time'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed by the cycle of time
data.etymology: Kalicharan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Time, Cycle, God's Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalicharan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Kalicharan is a name deeply rooted in Hindu culture with its origins in Sanskrit language. The name carries the echoes of ancient mythology where gods and goddesses are personifications of natural and cosmic forces.
